out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at two handwashing sinks: one in the far left corner behind the service line and one next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The person in charge corrected both of these violations during the inspection by providing paper towels at these locations.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the handwashing sink near the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The person in charge provided hand soap at the hand sink by the three compartment sink during the inspection to correct. BANH MI DC (Inspection Date: 10/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: there was no thermometer in the new steam bun cabinet located at the front counter.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. The person in charge provided a thermometer for this unit during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food stored on the floor in several locations, including in the main customer service area, in the walk-in refrigerator, and in several other locations.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Please discontinue storing food on the floor. Store food 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the handle for the ice scoop in the ice maker ice bin was stored in the ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS move the ice scoop during the inspection too correct.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the storage shelving in the walk-in refrigerator was visibly soiled with food debris, and in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean the storage shelving in the walk-in refrigerator as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: The employee shredded carrot and other vegetables (which will be cleaned, and served as is) was the handling the vegetables with bare hands. Bare hand contact with ready to eat foods is not permitted.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. The employee will wear gloves while performing this task in the future. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the employee rest room hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw eggs were stored directly over ready to eat pate in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC corrected this during the inspection by moving the eggs. CDI.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed interior portions of the ice machine were visibly soiled and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Clean the inside of the ice machine as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked bologna, cooked chicken, and fried tofu in the Beverage Air 2-door prep unit (left most of the three units) on the sandwich prep line were 49º, 50º, and 50º, respectively. Pandan tofu in the new dessert display unit was 49ºF. Cream in the right display case on the right side of the retail side was not cold enough at 42º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The manager stated the foods in the sandwich prep unit were all cooling for between 2 and 5 hours, however the ambient temperature of the unit was too high at 45ºF. The unit the pandan tofu was being displayed in was cold enough according to the unit thermometer, but due to the open front of ht display unit and the location of the food in the unit (in the front), the foods are not being held cold enough. The EHS suggested that the PIC move the food further back in the unit to keep the foods cold. Since the pandan tofu was made yesterday, it was discarded because it was out of temperature for more than 4 hours. The cream was discarded.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed numerous drain or fruit flies present in the flour storage room and the pate sho prep room.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC has a pest control contractor, but flies are still present. Please contact your pest control operator and have them increase pest control methods to eliminate the flies. Correct within 10 days or by Friday, April 24, 2026.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Toilet Rooms
violations.observation: Observed oil for deep fat fryers stored in the employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored in toilet rooms. Oil for frying is considered a food. Discontinue stored oil and any other foods in the restroom. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food stored on the floor in several locations throughout the establishment. Cases of canned food, fresh produce, bags of rice, etc. are stored on the floor. A bag of rice was stored on the floor under the hand sink next to the office door.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing food on the floor. Do not store food under hand sinks. Correct before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Observed wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Discontinue storing wet wiping cloths on the counter, instead store them in a sanitizing solution such as the one used for washing dishes and equipment at the three compartment sink. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed cases of single use items (to go containers, cups, lids, plastic utensils, etc.) and clean pots,, pans, and other equipment stored on the floor in several locations in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. Discontinue storing any food equipment on the floor. Store on approved shelving. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. BANH MI DC (Inspection Date: 04/14/2026) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: several plastic home-standard colanders were severely damaged, cracked, stained and deteriorated.
violations.corrective_action: Remove the deteriorated and stained colanders, they are no longer approved. Replace with food-grade colanders that are easily cleanable. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. BANH MI DC (Inspection Date: 04/14/2026) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Three refrigerator units were not keeping foods cold enough and need repair/service. The ambient temperature of the left-most refrigerator unit on the sandwich prep line was 45º (should be 39º or below to keep foods 41º or below). The ambient temperature of the True 2-door glass front unit where the jar of jellies are stored was 48º (should be 39º or below). Foods on the cold rail were not cold enough (no ambient temp available). The ambient temperature of the right display case on the right side of the retail portion of the establishment was 42º and cream in it was not cold enough.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the units so they are able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use these units to store time/temperature control for safety foods while they are not operating properly. The manager stated he would he would have the units serviced. Contact your EHS when the units have been serviced and are working properly. The cold rail unit was being filled with water, not ice, to keep foods cold, but the water was not touching the stainless steel pans the food were stored in. This unit is refrigerated and should be able to keep food cold without water. However, it is recommended that ice be used instead of water, if necessary, and the pans should be touching the ice in order to keep the jellies cold enough. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who said he would consider it.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed plastic milk and produce crates being reused throughout the establishment to store food, equipment, utensils and other items.
violations.corrective_action: Plastic milk and produce crates are not approved for reuse. Discontinue reusing plastic milk and produce crates. Instead, use other equipment that are easily cleanable. Use stainless steel or food grade plastic to store food and food equipment. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the refrigerator door handles have caked on food debris on them.
violations.corrective_action: Clean all the refrigerator door handles as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: all of the cooking equipment under the hood system (the wok line, burners, and single burners had significant amounts of grease and food debris on the and appear to have not been cleaned in a long time.
violations.corrective_action: Clean all the equipment under the hood as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Construction Materials
violations.observation: Observed two hoses being used in the establishment, one of which was being used for food (a food employees used this hose, which had a garden hose end sprayer attached, to add water to the pandan leaves mixture). Neither hose is food-grade or approved for use with food. The garden hose end sprayer is not approved for use with food.
violations.corrective_action: Hoses are used for food, must be food grade. The ones being used are not. Remove the non-food grade hose being used for food and replace with a food- grade hose, if still needed. Also, remove the garden sprayer being used for food. It is not approved for a food establishment. Correct within 3 days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed two hoses connected to hose bib spigots without vacuum breakers installed, as required. Also, the hoses are not food grade hoses and are being used for food.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Install vacuum breakers on both hoses. Replace the hoses with food grade hoses. Correct within 3 days, by Friday, April 17, 2026.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. Install an air gap on the sanitizing basin of the three compartment sink within 3 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed damaged walls in several areas including but not limited to the pate sho prep area, the flour storage area room, the area where the vegetables are shredded, the employee restroom, and others. There were large gaps in the ceiling panels where oven exhausts are installed and passing through the ceiling to the roof. These gaps must be properly sealed. Several ceiling panels were damaged, misplaced or missing. Several ceiling lighting fixtures were partially or not working, and need to be repaired or replaced.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. All holes in walls and deteriorated walls must be repaired and be kept in good repair. Repair all damaged walls, ceiling panels, and oven vents and repair or replaced all non-working or partially working ceiling light fixtures as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. A mop was stored on the floor between a refrigerator and an oven in the food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. Discontinue storing mops on the floor and store them so they can air dry between uses. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the following physical structure items are visibly soiled, very dusty, or stained and in need of cleaning: 1. All walls in the establishment, 2. all ceiling fans, 3. All HVAC ceiling diffusers, 4. All shelving especially under prep tables, 5. Numerous ceiling panels, 6. The wooden base of the stand mixer.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean these areas as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. Clean or replace the wooden base of the stand mixer within the same timeframe.
